description: Applied Drilling Engineering (Bourgoyne, Millheim, Chenevert, Young; SPE Textbook Series Vol. 2, 1991) chapter 8 survey-calculation example: due-north build at 3 deg/100 ft from vertical to 60 deg at 2,000 ft MD. Published results (minimum curvature and radius of curvature, exact for this planar constant-build well): TVD 1,653.99 ft, north displacement 954.93 ft at TD; balanced tangential 1,653.61 / 954.72; tangential 1,628.61 / 998.02; angle-averaging 1,654.18 / 955.04. Values as republished with attribution in Amorin & Broni-Bediako, Research Journal of Applied Sciences, Engineering and Technology 2(7):679-686, 2010 (open access; archived at /root/wds-literature/minimum_curvature_wellpath_maxwellsci.pdf), Tables 1/4/B and Fig. A. Closed-form check: R = 100/(3 pi/180) ft; TVD = R sin 60; ND = R (1 - cos 60).
